name: print-social-lime-black-grey-business-tips-social-post-pack-with-angular-cards
title: Lime, Black and Grey Business Post Pack
whatItIs: A green-backed stock preview of three square posts: a white post '4 TIPS FOR BUILDING START-UP' with a lime angular card and faint line art, a black post 'DREAMS don't work unless yo do.' with a lime card and repeating ghost words, and a grey post 'EXPLORE THE MARKET' on a black slanted card, with feature icons below.
whatItMeans: A lime slanted card carries the message in every colourway, so black, white and grey versions still belong together.
techniques: Lime angular card as the shared element
Three colourways of the same card system
Repeating ghost word lines behind a headline
Feature icons listing size, editable and layered

vocabulary.definition: A version of a layout in a different colour scheme.
A card whose edges are cut at an angle.
The same word repeated in faint type as texture.
